clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or the specialist authority specified in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: NCCP does not recommend dose reduction. Treatment interruption, discontinuation and an infusion-rate change are distinct actions. Restart requires documented source recovery and consultant confirmation.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00105 Version 7. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: Treatment of advanced melanoma in adults.

treatment.schedule_summary: Ipilimumab 3 mg/kg IV over 90 minutes every 21 days for up to 4 doses. Complete the four-dose induction as tolerated; source footnote limits completion to 16 weeks from first dose. New lesions/growth alone are not an automatic discontinuation instruction; consultant response assessment follows induction.
treatment.duration_text: Up to 4 doses, completed within 16 weeks from first dose, whichever occurs earlier.

administration.note: Infuse over 90 minutes; vital signs every 30 minutes during infusion and for 1 hour afterwards.
